conversation.text: You mentioned feeling little support. What is happening?

My team lead is on calls with Europe all day, so when I get stuck on billing disputes my messages wait until the next morning and cases sit a day. A 15-minute fixed slot each day or a backup person to ask would really help avoid delays like yesterday when a customer credit note waited two days.

Here is what I will tell HR: The employee experiences delays handling billing disputes because the team lead is unavailable during the day.
